name: Etsy Fee Calculator
formula: gross = item_price * quantity + shipping_charged; listing_fee = 0.20 * quantity; transaction_fee = 0.065 * gross; payment_processing_fee = gross * processing_rate(country) + processing_fixed(country); offsite_ads_fee = attributed ? min(gross * offsite_ads_rate, 100) : 0; total_fees = listing_fee + transaction_fee + payment_processing_fee + offsite_ads_fee (each fee line rounded to cent, half-up, before summing); net_payout = gross - total_fees
rounding: each fee line rounded to the nearest cent (half-up), then summed
assumptions: Seller is on the standard Etsy fee schedule (no negotiated rates).
Fixed processing fee is charged in the seller-country currency; the calculator performs no FX conversion.
Transaction fee base is item price + shipping charged (gift wrap not modeled).
Offsite Ads rate is user-selected (15% under $10k annual sales / 12% at or above), capped at $100 per attributed order.
Regulatory operating fee (0.05%-1.97%, region-specific) and regulated-category surcharge (+2.5%) are NOT included -- UI must state exclusions.
source: etsy-listing-fee, etsy-transaction-fee, etsy-processing-fee-us, etsy-processing-fee-uk, etsy-processing-fee-de-fr, etsy-processing-fee-ca-au, etsy-offsite-ads-fee

name: Etsy Profit Calculator
formula: gross = sale_price + shipping_charged; total_fees = (same Etsy fee engine as tool-055: listing + transaction + processing [+ offsite ads]); total_costs = item_cost + shipping_label_cost + total_fees; net_profit = gross - total_costs; profit_margin = net_profit / gross * 100
rounding: each fee line rounded to the nearest cent (half-up); net profit and margin rounded half-up (2 decimals / 1 decimal)
assumptions: Same fee engine, values, rounding, and exclusions as tool-055 (shares the Etsy rule set).
COGS, packaging, and other overheads beyond shipping label are user-entered; negative profit is shown with a warning.
source: etsy-listing-fee, etsy-transaction-fee, etsy-processing-fee-us, etsy-processing-fee-uk, etsy-processing-fee-de-fr, etsy-processing-fee-ca-au, etsy-offsite-ads-fee (same rule set as tool-055)

name: eBay Fee Calculator
formula: total_sale = sale_price + shipping_charged; final_value_fee = 0.136 * min(total_sale, 7500) + 0.0235 * max(total_sale - 7500, 0) [+ 0.0165 * total_sale if international_buyer]; per_order_fee = total_sale > 10 ? 0.40 : 0.30; insertion_fee = max(listings_beyond_250, 0) * 0.35 (optional input); total_fees = final_value_fee + per_order_fee + insertion_fee; net_payout = total_sale - total_fees
assumptions: Default most-categories FVF 13.6%; sources disagree (13.6% vs 13.25% seen Jul 2026+) -- UI MUST carry an 'estimate, rates under review' label (needs_review).
Category overrides (e.g. 15.3% Books/DVDs/Music, 6.7% guitars) applied when the user selects a category.
$7,500 tier applies per item; FVF is on total sale amount (price + shipping + tax where applicable).
source: ebay-fvf-most-categories, ebay-fvf-rate-discrepancy, ebay-per-order-fee, ebay-insertion-fee, ebay-category-rates, ebay-international-fee

name: Amazon KDP Royalty Calculator

name: PayPal Fee Calculator
formula: fee = amount * rate(route) + fixed(route); rate/fixed by route: direct_gs 2.99%+0, checkout 3.49%+0.49, card 2.99%+0.49; international adds +1.5% to rate; net_received = amount - fee; effective_rate = fee / amount * 100; reverse_amount(target) = (target + fixed) / (1 - rate)

variables.meaning: direct_gs / checkout / card (REQUIRED -- no single blended rate)

assumptions: Direct G&S has NO fixed fee (2.99%) while Checkout adds $0.49 -- the route must be explicit; a single blended PayPal rate is wrong.
US domestic schedule; international +1.5% (4.49%+$0.49 intl G&S per rules).
Currency conversion is a 3-4% spread above mid-market, shown as a note, not folded into the fee.

assumptions: US domestic schedule; method must be explicit (in-person 2.7%+$0.05 differs from online).
